means = [pop["annual_spend"]

code:
heavy = pop[pop["orders_per_year"]
            >= 6]
bs = heavy.sample(n=2000,
                  random_state=1)
bs["annual_spend"].mean()
# 241.55   truth is 170.22
caption: 2,000 respondents, still far off. More data won't fix bias.

steps.label: Selection bias
steps.sub: Only some people can be reached

code:
strat = pop.groupby("region",
   group_keys=False).apply(
   lambda g: g.sample(frac=0.002,
                      random_state=3))
# North 100, South 60, West 40
strat["annual_spend"].mean()
# 174.39
caption: Each region appears in proportion to its size.
